items_flat.title_en: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 5.5, first model in the Claude 5.5 family
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Opus 5.5，Claude 5.5 家族首發
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced Claude Opus 5.5 as available today, calling it the first model in a new Claude 5.5 family. Official copy says it performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 for most work and costs about 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads. API pricing is $4 / $20 per million input / output tokens (20% below Opus 5), with cache reads at $0.20 (60% below Opus 5). The company said Frontier Design and METR tested it before launch; Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 are slated for the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Opus 5.5 即日起可用，為新 Claude 5.5 家族首款模型。官方稱多數工作表現達 Claude Fable 5.1 水準，典型負載運行成本較 Opus 5 約低 40%。API 為每百萬 token 輸入 $4、輸出 $20（較 Opus 5 低 20%），快取讀取 $0.20（低 60%）。公司表示發布前經 Frontier Design 與 METR 外部測試；Sonnet 5.5 與 Haiku 5.5 將於未來數週推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a mid-cycle price/performance squeeze on Anthropic’s daily-driver Opus tier, not a claimed new intelligence peak: the pitch is Fable-class utility at a cheaper Opus bill, with safety language framed as the first ship after Amodei’s “pace the frontier” call. Independent confirmation of the coding-cost claims and of how often Fable-class safeguards throttle real tasks remains the open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對日常主力 Opus 檔的中期性價比壓縮，而非宣稱新的智力高峰：賣點是接近 Fable 的實用性、更便宜的 Opus 帳單，並把安全敘事綁在 Amodei「放慢前沿」之後的首次出貨。編碼成本優勢與 Fable 級防護會多常卡住真實任務，仍待獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 Claude Opus 5.5，這是新 Claude 5.5 家族的第一款模型。它在多數工作上達到 Claude Fable 5.1 的水準，運行成本較 Opus 5 低 40%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands GPT-6 with Sol and Luna, cuts API prices 50%
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴充 GPT-6：推出 Sol 與 Luna，API 價格腰斬
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as faster, cheaper siblings that it says were trained with similar methods to GPT-6 Astra. API prices fall 50% versus GPT-5.6 promotional rates: Sol to $2 / $10 per million input / output tokens, Luna to $0.10 / $0.50. Both are in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus through Edu; Luna is also in the desktop app for Free and Go. OpenAI attributes the cut to caching and inference gains.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-6 Luna，定位為較快、較便宜的 Astra 同代模型，並稱訓練方法相近。API 價較 GPT-5.6 促銷價降 50%：Sol 為每百萬 token 輸入 $2、輸出 $10，Luna 為 $0.10 / $0.50。兩者已進入 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex（Plus 至 Edu）；Luna 亦對 Free／Go 桌面版開放。OpenAI 將降價歸因於快取與推論效率提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: OpenAI is productizing Astra’s generation as a cost ladder rather than waiting for another flagship: Sol is positioned as the scaled workhorse, Luna as high-volume cheap inference. Third-party scoring so far describes intelligence as roughly level with the GPT-5.6 siblings, so the day’s claim is price, not a new capability ceiling.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 把 Astra 這一代做成成本階梯，而不是再等下一款旗艦：Sol 當規模化主力、Luna 當高量便宜推論。目前第三方評分多指智力大致與 GPT-5.6 同檔同級，今日真正落地的是價格，不是新的能力天花板。
items_flat.quote: We’ve also made caching and inference more efficient, and we’re passing the savings directly to you: 50% lower API prices for Sol and Luna compared with GPT‑5.6 promotional pricing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們也讓快取與推論更有效率，並把節省直接回饋給你：Sol 與 Luna 的 API 價格較 GPT-5.6 促銷價低 50%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes priorities for independent third-party safety assessments
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公布獨立第三方安全評估的優先事項與原則
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a safety post committing to support independent assessments with access across training, evaluation, and deployment, framed as part of its effort to “pace the frontier.” The note lists four priority areas: safety cases; critical safeguards; Preparedness and alignment evaluations; and independent investigation of critical misalignment incidents. It also sets principles on scope, access, independence, confidentiality, remediation windows, and publication. No named assessor or access contract was attached.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布安全文章，承諾在訓練、評估與部署階段支持具深度存取的獨立評估，並將此納入「放慢前沿」作為。文中列出四項優先：安全論證（safety cases）、關鍵防護、Preparedness／對齊評估，以及重大錯位事件的獨立調查；並訂定範圍、存取、獨立性、保密、補正期與發布原則。文中未點名評估機構，也未附存取合約。
items_flat.analysis_en: This converts a recent executive pledge into a process document, not a completed audit: it defines what OpenAI wants assessors to look at and how findings might be handled, while leaving partner names, access terms, and publish-without-redaction rights unspecified. Effectiveness will turn on whether those terms are signed, not on the blog’s four headings.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是把近期高階承諾落成流程文件，不是已完成的稽核：它定義 OpenAI 希望評估方看什麼、發現如何處理，但夥伴名稱、存取條件與可否不經刪改公開仍未寫死。成敗取決於那些條款有沒有簽成，而不是部落格上的四個標題。
items_flat.quote: As part of our efforts to pace the frontier, OpenAI is committed to supporting independent assessments with deep levels of access across training, evaluation, and deployment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為我們放慢前沿努力的一環，OpenAI 承諾支持在訓練、評估與部署階段具深度存取的獨立評估。

items_flat.title_en: Xiaomi open-sources MiMo-V2.6 Pro and Flash omnimodal models
items_flat.title_zh: 小米開源全模態 MiMo-V2.6 Pro／Flash
items_flat.summary_en: Xiaomi released and open-sourced the MiMo-V2.6 series on September 22, including natively omnimodal MiMo-V2.6-Pro and MiMo-V2.6-Flash, plus a Pro-UltraSpeed serving mode it says can reach up to 20x output speed. Official copy says Pro scores 46.32 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and claims the strongest open-source result versus Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max, while keeping V2.5 API prices. Models are live in MiMo AI Studio, Code, Desktop, the MiMo API, and OpenRouter.
items_flat.summary_zh: 小米於 9 月 22 日發布並開源 MiMo-V2.6 系列，含原生全模態的 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 與 MiMo-V2.6-Flash，以及宣稱輸出可快至 20 倍的 Pro-UltraSpeed 服務模式。官方稱 Pro 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 得 46.32，並自稱勝過 Kimi K3 與 Qwen3.8 Max，為當前最強開源成績，API 價維持 V2.5。模型已上線 MiMo AI Studio、Code、Desktop、官方 API 與 OpenRouter。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the day’s notable open-weights move: a Chinese lab claiming the open-source intelligence lead while holding price flat. The 46.32 index figure and the closed-model gap Xiaomi itself flags versus Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra should be treated as vendor-reported until the public leaderboard snapshot is independently timestamped.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是今日值得記的開源權重動作：一家中國實驗室在價格不動下宣稱開源智力領先。46.32 指數與小米自己標出的相對 Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 落差，在公開榜單快照被獨立對時前，應視為廠商自述。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing and open-sourcing the MiMo-V2.6 series. This marks a key step in our exploration of the RSI path: scaling RL compute on verifiable, complex tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布並開源 MiMo-V2.6 系列。這是我們探索 RSI 路徑的關鍵一步：在可驗證的複雜任務上擴張強化學習算力。
